scope: Step7 syntax recovery and public caller gates; planning only
contract: A malformed declaration must not hide independent diagnostics in valid siblings; suppress local dependent cascades. Parser admission, check_program best effort, and compile refusal are distinct.

landed_fixes.summary: Removed whole-subtree Resolver::index_module gate; malformed owner identity wrapped in Error, preventing false ownership.
landed_fixes.classification: supported invariant; do not rediscover removed resolver gate as current bug

landed_fixes.summary: Shared decoded strings across analysis callers; invalid strings retain no payload and valid siblings remain checked.

findings.impact: Fresh public CatalogAnalyzer controls show E4011 at valid secret-return sibling drops after malformed policy, despite preserved module/scenario CST. Effect module/scenario records also disappear. E4004 survives via check_app_policies iterating resolver symbols independently; do not claim all E4 findings disappear. Additional executed clean valid-policy control becomes E1200 [22,22) plus false E4004 Config [24,30) after an unrelated malformed policy. Valid Policy and Model CST survive, but module/model effect records are empty; finish interprets absent effect policy data as absence of authored policy.

Fresh public CatalogAnalyzer E4020 control drops after malformed policy in same module and after malformed policy in another module in same source. Crossmodule effects still record valid scenario, isolating root-wide position-independent walk from module-level gate.

Unrelated malformed policy causes recursive owner gate to omit valid source="fr" metadata. module_source_tag defaults to en, so check_message_value loses real E3016 duplicate fr (control [51,53), shifted malformed fr [59,61) absent), and invents false E3016 duplicate en [59,61) for a valid en translation (clean control). E1200 [34,34) remains; full CST coverage and valid Message admission hold in all cases. Production CLI check and compile reproduce both diagnostic differences.

findings.classification: demonstrated admission limit; synchronization policy boundary
findings.impact: Open delimiter joins all following physical code lines until close or EOF; independent-looking declaration/section lines are never handed to parser as siblings. Existing grammar says newline ends only at depth zero; no unrequested synchronization policy selected.

Public helper assumes quoted nonempty raw string via debug_assert and len-1; malformed raw helper argument may panic (empty input). Production lexer only calls it after matching quotes; source text escape recovery already has witnesses.
Checks Error nodes only, unlike semantic has_error including BadToken; invalid String payload E1006 also need not create Error. Consumers must gate compilation on diagnostics, as CLI does.

pipeline.behavior: lex/layout/parse all execute; concatenate and sort diagnostics; debug coverage assertion
No global errors gate: parses all files, executes resolve/types/emit_unresolved/effects/examples then dedup/sort
Loads catalog and always check_program; complete means passes available, not errors absent
Compile file read failures E7002 early return; after all analysis errors emit diagnostics and refuse codegen; emission errors refuse artifact
Retains parse tree, check_program diagnostics/program, separately resolved tables without syntax error global return

lexical_and_layout_invariants.behavior: Input API str valid UTF8; raw bytes lex_bytes rejects invalid UTF8 E1002 at valid_up_to one byte. Names ASCII A-Z a-z underscore then ASCII alnum/underscore; no Unicode normalization. Strings/prose Unicode scalar text allowed; unknown code scalar full byte span E1007.

LF and CRLF preserved as CST trivia; bare CR E1001, code error token prevents duplicate lex diagnostic. Space indentation, tabs E1003; tabs inside #/## prose allowed; tabs inside string rejected E1006.

JSON escapes quote backslash slash b f n r t and u four hex; paired high/low surrogates decode scalar, lone/malformed surrogate E1006; physical newline terminates invalid string. Invalid String retained, payload None, not fabricated empty string. Multibyte malformed escapes use checked get slices.

Mismatched close E1101 pops one open level; EOF E1102 flush pending tokens. Blank/comments do not join. Descriptions attach same column, ineligible/inert E1126, dangling E1125 marker preserved. Malformed ref/suffix local return empty reference/None rather than abandoning file.

Missing token uses zero-width piece EOF; transactional builder rewinds byte/comment cursors and diagnostics before raw recovery; iterative Error wrapping avoids recursive runaway; trivia/comments and Description leaves retain bytes exactly once.

return_inventory_definition: All executable lines containing return keyword after quoted literal text is excluded in the four assigned syntax files; symbol is nearest fn declaration (includes local fn). Implicit ?, Err expressions and loop continue handled by phase/transaction descriptions, not misrepresented as keyword inventory. Test bodies included where return occurs.
